properties.content: Question: inflation rate usa Answer: The latest US inflation rate, as of June 2025, is 2.7%. This means prices for goods and services have increased by 2.7% compared to the same period last year, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. The core inflation rate, which excludes food and energy prices, is slightly higher at 2.9%. Here's a more detailed breakdown:: - Overall Inflation: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) for all items increased by 2.7% over the past 12 months, reports the Bureau of Labor Statistics. - Core Inflation: Core CPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, rose by 2.9% over the past year, according to Bankrate. - Monthly Change: On a monthly basis, the CPI increased by 0.3% in June. - Recent Trends: While inflation has shown signs of moderating from the higher levels seen in 2021 and 2022, it has recently picked up again. - Future Expectations: The next update on the US inflation rate will be released on August 12th.

Question: inflation rate usa

Answer: The latest US inflation rate, as of June 2025, is 2.7%. This means prices for goods and services have increased by 2.7% compared to the same period last year, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. The core inflation rate, which excludes food and energy prices, is slightly higher at 2.9%.
Here's a more detailed breakdown::
- Overall Inflation: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) for all items increased by 2.7% over the past 12 months, reports the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
- Core Inflation: Core CPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, rose by 2.9% over the past year, according to Bankrate.
- Monthly Change: On a monthly basis, the CPI increased by 0.3% in June.
- Recent Trends: While inflation has shown signs of moderating from the higher levels seen in 2021 and 2022, it has recently picked up again.
- Future Expectations: The next update on the US inflation rate will be released on August 12th.
